notes: Printed as matrix (pressure rows x six temperature columns); restacked by temperature, 12, 18, 25, 31.04, 35, 40 C, only filled cells written. The text states a solid hexahydrate (hydrate) formed at 12 C above 300 atm and complete miscibility near 500 atm at 12 C; no tabulated row is flagged hydrate, so regime is left empty. Liquid CO2-rich phase is present at pressures above the CO2 vapour pressure at the lower temperatures (text: 'two liquid systems') but rows are not flagged by the authors; regime not assigned per row. Original table has no 10 C values (text mentions a single 150 atm series at 10 C that is not tabulated).
quality_remarks: audit 2026-10-02: data row 45 (40 C, 200 atm, printed 31.74) is a suspected misprint (probably 30.74): the authors' Table III experimental 0.0243 at 200 atm agrees with 30.74 and not with 31.74 (0.0250). Printed value kept.
